content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: All information disclosed hereinafter referred to as 'Confidential Information' shall remain confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Duration
content_blocks.text: The confidentiality obligations herein shall survive the termination of this agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Exceptions
